subject: O Level Physics
title: Wave on a rope
question:
A horizontal rope is vibrated up and down 2.5 times per second. Fig. 9.1 shows the displacement-distance graph of the wave formed in the rope at t = 0 s. Two points A and B are marked on the rope.
(b) Describe the motion of point A for the next 0.30 s.
(e) Explain what will happen to the speed and wavelength of the wave if the rope is vibrated at twice its original frequency.
referenceNote: The original figure from the physics paper.

scene: The wave has a wavelength of 0.4 m, the same as the original, and B sits exactly on the curve.
